evidence.document: SCB Dokumentation av statistikens framtagning (UF0315, 2006–2008), embedded questionnaire question 13
evidence.question: The native edition is “2006 - 2008”; its VariabelReferenstid “Enkäten Innovationsverksamhet 2004-2006” conflicts with the edition and is treated as stale for this reviewed coordinate. The answer meanings come from the wave's own questionnaire, question 13 (“Vilken lokalisering hade företagets samarbetspartner under åren 2006–2008?”), rows a–h by five locations plus Inte aktuell. SWECOV's CIS2008 holdings name the answers co<row><location> by questionnaire position: the maintainer's aggregate MONA check (2026-10-14) found the 4-location waves (CIS2004, CIS2006) carry co11–co14 with no co15, so the location digit is the questionnaire column, and partner rows a–e have the same meaning under positional and later-wave readings. Only rows a–e are declared; co6x/co7x stay held (#1571). This questionnaire has eight partner rows (e Konsulter, privata laboratorier; f Privata FoU-institut; g Universitet eller högskolor; h Offentliga forskningsinstitut) while SWECOV's CIS2008 holdings carry seven co row groups (co1x–co7x), so position cannot fix rows 6 and 7. The eighth row comes from splitting the 2002–2004 row e (consultants, private laboratories, private R&D institutes) into e and f, and no SCB document says how the delivery folds eight rows into seven (e.g. e+f merged with co6x = g and co7x = h as in 2002–2004, or one row dropped). The document's variable register names no value set for the matrix variable “Typ av samarbetspartner geografiskt fördelat”: its 8-alternative set belongs to “Mest värdefulla samarbetspartner”, and the 7-alternative “Typ av samarbetspartner” set is carried over verbatim from the 2002–2004 documentation. No other cell is asserted. SCB's quality declaration Appendix 2 (uf0315_kd_2018_ah_191113.pdf, pp. 23–27) lists this wave's questionnaire items on the same rows but names no co columns for it.
